answer: Each task nonce is derived after registration from a specified future drand quicknet round, whose threshold-BLS pulse is unpredictable and publicly verifiable. Responses commit to that nonce and must reveal a valid solution before expiry. A sparrow swarm therefore cannot precompute reusable answers offline: every spiral of identities faces fresh beacon-bound work, so parallel Sybil attempts require new computation rather than replaying cached proofs.
